This fixes the issue reported in this comment: https://github.com/fastapi/fastapi/pull/14851#issuecomment-3863896385

```py

    print("SYNC START", flush=True)
```

steps.message: The fix was to move the initialization of `self.on_startup` and `self.on_shutdown` in `APIRouter.__init__` to after the call to `super().__init__`, preventing the parent class from overriding these attributes.

The bug was caused by `APIRouter.__init__` assigning `self.on_startup` and `self.on_shutdown` before calling `super().__init__`, which resulted in the parent class (`starlette.routing.Router`) overriding these attributes and clearing the provided startup and shutdown handlers. The fix moves these assignments to occur after the `super().__init__` call, ensuring that the handlers are correctly preserved and subsequently used by the lifespan context.
